text:
alex.taylor: Hey team — first day! I just unboxed my MacBook Pro (M1) and the MDM enrollment is failing during setup with 'Profile install failed (403)'. FileVault didn't enable either. Asset tag RWI-0472. Anyone free to help?
it-support: Welcome Alex 👋 Can you paste the exact error text or a screenshot? Also send the serial or asset tag (got RWI-0472). Quick checks you can run in Terminal: `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo fdesetup status`.
alex.taylor: outputs: `profiles: No enrolled profile found` and `FileVault is Off`. Also saw a system pop-up saying "System extension from 'Redwood MDM' was blocked" under Security & Privacy.
it-support: Thanks. Two likely issues: 1) the MDM push didn't complete (403 from our endpoint) or 2) macOS blocked the MDM system extension during first-run. I'm pushing a re-enroll token now. After that try `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and reboot. If the system blocks an extension, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → and look for an "Allow" button for Redwood MDM after reboot.
lina-ops: pushed re-enroll token to RWI-0472 and retried enrollment from the console. You should get a macOS notification to accept the enrollment and complete Okta SSO.
alex.taylor: got a notification "Corporate device enrollment requested" — clicked Accept, it redirected me to Okta and I completed SSO.
it-support: Check enrollment status again: `sudo profiles status -type enrollment`
alex.taylor: now shows `profiles: Enrolled via MDM (mdm.redwood.internal)` — looks green.
it-support: Great. I've also kicked the FileVault enable policy. You should see a modal to enable FileVault and choose whether to escrow a recovery key to our KMS or store a local recovery key. Please follow the prompts and set a password.
alex.taylor: went through the flow, accepted escrow to KMS. `sudo fdesetup status` now reports `FileVault is On` :thumbsup:
sam: tagging inventory — serial C02X7YYYYY, added to asset DB, applied developer package and dev tools whitelist.
alex.taylor: everything works now, I can install Homebrew and VS Code. Huge thanks!
mdm-bot: Notice: Profile install completed for asset RWI-0472 at 2026-03-23T14:07:45Z.
alex.taylor: closing the thread — really appreciate the quick help :heart:
